_doc: SNG-232 — THE SEAM LEDGER. A 'seam' is a place where system A (producer) writes data that system B
(consumer) reads, under an UNSTATED contract both must honor. wiring_audit + content_ci catch WIRING and
SCHEMA; they do NOT catch two individually-valid systems that DISAGREE about the same data (the ~80% bug
class of the 2026-07 session: _gen boolean-vs-object, null-field readers, pool-vs-seed sources). This
ledger DECLARES the known producer->consumer contracts; tests/wiring_audit.mjs (runSeamAudit) gates on them.
DISCIPLINE (mirrors the wiring_audit registry philosophy):
- DECLARED, not inferred. We check the seams listed here; we do NOT try to discover every data handoff
(undecidable + noisy). Start with the seams that BROKE, grow by incident.
- GROWS BY INCIDENT. Every future seam bug adds ONE entry here + it becomes a permanent build gate.
- A SEAM CHECK THAT CANNOT FAIL IS THEATER. Each entry reads REAL producer/consumer code that a future
edit can break. runSeamAudit self-tests that its own matcher can go red before trusting a green.
ENTRY SHAPE:
id         kebab-case stable id
incident   the ticket that proved this seam matters (SNG-NNN / CCODE-NN)
kind       field-shape | cross-ref | enum-parity   (the class of disagreement)
contract   one line: what both ends must agree on
producer   { file, note }                 code-site backref: who writes the data
consumer   { file, region? }              code-site backref: who reads it; region = a function name to
scope the scan (omit for a whole-file scan with unique patterns)
assert     { requires:[regex...], forbids?:[regex...] }  ALL requires must be present in the consumer
region; NO forbids may be. Patterns are JS-RegExp source strings.
canFail    human note: the edit that turns this red (the falsifiability witness)

seams.contract: A generated location may OMIT dangerLevel; the consumer must floor a missing value (null is NOT 0 — a null-danger place could never roll a fight and starves the pool).

producer.note: a minted location can leave dangerLevel null (deriveDangerLevel backfills, but the reader must not assume it ran)

seams.canFail: Reintroduce SNG-225: read location.dangerLevel and coerce raw|0 with no null path (null->0). DANGER_FLOOR leaves dangerOf -> red.

seams.contract: The GM-offer path must read the encounter POOL (eligibleEncountersFor), not ONLY location.encounterSeeds — else SNG-225's pool + SNG-229's bestiary are unreachable through GM offers.

producer.note: eligibleEncountersFor(table, location) = the danger+tag-gated offerable pool

seams.canFail: Revert to a seeds-only offer list: eligibleEncountersFor leaves listAvailableEncounters -> red (the pool is unreachable again).

seams.contract: A GM-invented encounter (newEncounter) only REGISTERS a def; a fight STARTS only via a choice carrying its encounterId (onChoice path A). applyTurn must guarantee an engage choice when the GM didn't wire one.

consumer.note: onChoice path A starts an encounter from a choice.encounterId; applyTurn injects the bridging choice

seams.canFail: Remove the engage-choice injection from the newEncounter block: the invented duel registers but nothing engages it -> the CCODE-19 'fight won't start' bug returns; the patterns vanish -> red.
